description: Replacing propositional connectives by the NAND or NOR constructions preserves every valuation value.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.toGate_correct.{u} {α : Type u} (k : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GateKind)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.gateEval k v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.toGate k A) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval v A
